name: anchor_bead
doc: The pr evaluator holds the PR of the bead an open bead names, until that work is filed with a blocks edge. The merge anchor a review, rework, finding or validation child names (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.gates]). A listing names it on each bead, and prstatus's in-flight set reads it.

name: blocked_reason
doc: Why a bead on the record is blocked: the merge it awaits, or the exception that holds it.

name: branch
doc: The source branch a work bead's change is on, which the work formula's workspace-setup writes (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.merge_identity]). A bead carrying it is in flight. The pr evaluator and the landing order hold a PR whose head branch is not this one. A composition reads it for the PR's source branch, and finds the beads whose work the branch carries by it.

name: check_set
doc: The review checks a bead's change is gated by, as a comma list (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.gates]). A composition names it when no pre-open gate resolves from it.

name: epic_boundaries
doc: What an epic's work is not (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_closure_condition
doc: An epic's closure checks (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_handle
doc: An epic's 3-5 word handle (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_hypothesis
doc: An epic's one-sentence hypothesis (docs/epics.md). An epic under an epic that carries none is a Delivery.

name: epic_indicators
doc: An epic's leading indicators (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_ruling
doc: The latest ruling on an epic's hypothesis: continue, shift or close (docs/epics.md).

name: epic_ruling_at
doc: When the operator made the latest ruling on an epic.

name: epic_ruling_reason
doc: Why the latest ruling on an epic was made, written with it.

name: existing_pr
doc: The PR the refinery reuses rather than open another, a PR's URL: armed with the marker before the record's second write, and set by a requeue. A publication clears it.

name: fold_target
doc: The branch a bead's work was folded onto by a polecat (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.merge_identity]). A bead carrying it has its work on that branch.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready
doc: The pool or agent an armed bead is slung to once nothing holds it. Its presence is the arm.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_args
doc: The arm's extra sling arguments, as a JSON array.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_armed_at
doc: When the bead was armed, in RFC 3339 UTC.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_armed_by
doc: Who armed the bead.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_fail_count
doc: The sling attempts made on the arm, as an integer string.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_reason
doc: Why the bead was armed, as free text.

name: gc.dispatch_when_ready_slung
doc: The arm's sling marker: slinging@<time> while an attempt is in flight, slung@<time> once it is proven.

name: gc.formula_contract
doc: The formula contract a root was poured under. A root reading graph.v2 is a run's root.

name: gc.input_convoy_id
doc: The input convoy a graph.v2 workflow root was poured over. The convoy tracks the bead the run works, and the bead a live run works is in flight once the run has passed load-context. A root without it works the bead its gc.var.issue names.

name: gc.kind
doc: The runtime's kind of a bead. A root reading workflow is a run's root.

name: gc.notify_when_ready
doc: The named agent a notice is owed to once nothing holds the bead assigned to it. Its presence is the arm.

name: gc.root_bead_id
doc: The workflow root a step was poured under.

name: gc.routed_to
doc: The pool, agent or person a bead is routed to (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, ROUTE and [metadata.runtime_owned]). A bead on a branch that a pool still holds has not pushed its work. The pool or agent a bead is routed to, written by lifecycle.sh's --route and by the script or formula that owns the bead's dispatch (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, ROUTE and [metadata.runtime_owned]).

name: gc.step_ref
doc: The formula step a step bead carries out, as <formula>.<step>. A live run with an open step whose ref ends in .load-context has not passed load-context.

name: gc.var.issue
doc: The bead a classic molecule's issue variable names, which a root that names no input convoy works. A root whose input convoy tracks another bead works none.

name: gc.work_outcome
doc: A work bead's self-reported disposition (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.runtime_owned]). A bead reading no-op put no work on its branch. A work bead's self-reported disposition, no-op or shipped, whose meaning is the runtime's (lifecycle/lifecycle.toml, [metadata.runtime_owned]).

name: merge_hold
doc: A hold on the bead's merge, set by hand. Any value but an unset spelling holds the PR.

name: merge_result
doc: Where the work a bead carries stands on its way to its target. On Gas Town's pending record it reads pull_request_pending, pull_request_head_changed, mr_merged, pull_request_record_incomplete or one of the exceptions, pull_request_reconcile_invalid, pull_request_closed_unmerged, pull_request_merged_unvalidated_head, pull_request_merge_evidence_contradiction, pull_request_legacy_closed_unverified and pull_request_merged_close_refused, each of which keeps the bead blocked behind a human gate keyed by its value. Absent, the bead has not landed and owns no open PR. The old path's values are lifecycle/lifecycle.toml's [states]. A PR's composition reads a bead on its branch that carries one as the branch's anchor, and one that reads merged, or mr_merged, pull_request_merged_close_refused or pull_request_merged_unvalidated_head, as having landed its work on its merged_target.

name: merged_sha
doc: The merge commit the landing order found on the target when it closed the bead.

name: merged_target
doc: The branch the bead's PR is to merge into, the base its PR must name, and once it lands the branch it landed on. A PR's composition reads it to find the beads that landed on the PR's branch.

name: observed_pr_head_sha
doc: The head the landing order found on a PR open at a head the refinery has not validated. The next publication clears it.

name: pr_comment_answered
doc: The inline comment id through which the review threads have answered the comments past the comment watermark. A value that is not a whole number reads as 0.

name: pr_comment_watermark
doc: The highest inline comment id the intake has routed. A value that is not a whole number reads as 0.

name: pr_head_sha
doc: The head the refinery validated, the one head the bead's PR may merge at. A requeue keeps it.

name: pr_issue_comment_watermark
doc: The highest conversation comment id the intake has routed. A value that is not a whole number reads as 0.

name: pr_last_checked_at
doc: When the record was last written or read, RFC 3339 UTC to the second. The landing order reads the records it checked least recently first.

name: pr_merged_at
doc: When GitHub says the PR merged, recorded with the merge commit.

name: pr_number
doc: The number of the PR the record names, in decimal.

name: pr_provenance_since
doc: The instant from which a post under the city's login is feedback unless it carries the city's mark. A value that is not an instant in GitHub's form makes every such post the city's own.

name: pr_reconcile_error
doc: Why the landing order's last read could not decide, such as a lookup that failed or a merge commit not yet on the fetched target. The next run reads the record again, and a read that decides clears it.

name: pr_reconcile_pending
doc: true while a reconciliation of the record is still owed, the marker the landing order selects the records it reads by. The record's first write sets it, and the order clears it when the bead closes on a verified merge, goes back to the refinery, meets an exception or has been released from the refinery. A disposition's close clears it in the same write, through bead-rehome.sh, the one shell writer that spells it, because only that write closes the bead under the record lock.

name: pr_repo
doc: The repository of the PR the record names, owner/name, which matches the rig's origin and is compared without case.

name: pr_review_answered
doc: The review id through which the review threads have answered the reviews past the review watermark. A value that is not a whole number reads as 0.

name: pr_review_watermark
doc: The highest review id the intake has routed. A value that is not a whole number reads as 0.

name: pr_state
doc: The PR's state as the landing order last read it: open, merged, or the state a read that could not decide or an exception left, such as lookup_failed, merge_unreachable or closed_unmerged.

name: pr_summary
doc: The account of what a change does, for its PR, in freeform markdown. `gctk pr summary` is its one writer: the polecat records it on the anchor at submit, and an integration effort's summary task on the effort's landing bead once the effort's work has landed. The PR's managed summary region carries it (`gctk pr compose`), and `gctk pr summary` prints it for a reader of the PR's text. Absent or blank, the dispatch text stands in. Never cleared: the next record replaces it.

name: pr_url
doc: The URL of the PR the record names, https://<host>/<owner>/<repo>/pull/<number>.

name: rebase_hold
doc: A hold on bringing the bead's branch current, set by hand. Any value but an unset spelling holds the PR.

name: rejection_reason
doc: Why the work was sent back to the refinery: a head it has not validated, or a record left half written. A publication clears it.

name: review_results
doc: The review loop's results on the bead that owns a PR, a JSON array of {head, target, passed}, one for each head and target the loop judged. The evaluator counts only a result for the PR's live head and target.

name: rig_check.lint
doc: The published copy of a recorded check's result, which `gctk rig <check> --publish-bead <bead>` writes on the bead its caller names: the record the call answered with, as one JSON object of check, result, scope (absent on a lint or typecheck run), commit, tree, exit_code, duration_ms, runner, recorded_at and command. gctk writes it only once the record store holds the result it copies, after recording a result or answering from a record. No pack path reads it: the record under the rig clone's git common directory answers a later call. Absent means no call published that check to the bead. Never cleared: the next publish replaces it. Its commit is the one the check ran at: the head the call answered for, or, for a full-suite test pass answered through the tree, an earlier commit with the same tree.
